import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react"; import { useParams } from "react-router-dom"; import { api } from "@/api"; import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card"; import { ResponsiveContainer, LineChart, Line, XAxis, YAxis, Tooltip, Legend, CartesianGrid, } from "recharts"; import { FlaskConical } from "lucide-react"; /** * QuoteIQ Q1-UI · Per-customer chemistry profitability trend. * Distinct from the existing dose-calculator ``CustomerChemistry`` page. * * Route: /customers/:id/chemistry-history * Data: GET /api/pools/{customer_id}/chemical-profitability?months=N */ export default function CustomerChemistryHistory() { const { id } = useParams(); const [months, setMonths] = useState(6); const [data, setData] = useState(null); useEffect(() => { api .get(`/pools/${id}/chemical-profitability?months=${months}`) .then(setData) .catch(() => setData({ series: [], totals: { total_cost_cents: 0, visit_count: 0 } })); }, [id, months]); const centsToDollars = (c) => `$${((c || 0) / 100).toFixed(2)}`; const chartData = (data?.series || []).map((s) => ({ month: s.month, cost: (s.total_cost_cents || 0) / 100, visits: s.visit_count, })); return (

Chemistry Profitability

Cost of chemicals applied to this pool over the last {months} months.

Total chemical spend
{centsToDollars(data?.totals?.total_cost_cents)}
Visits with chemicals
{data?.totals?.visit_count ?? 0}
Monthly trend {chartData.length === 0 ? (
No chemistry usage recorded in this window.
) : ( )}
); }
